narrative: 切开的是建筑本身，而不是影片的剪辑。一栋房子可以变成一台机械装置，一家夜店可以变成一连串房间，一具身体可以变成一扇门。
观众被赋予了对空间的全知视角。如果你借助一辆驶过的卡车来隐藏剪辑点，那你得到的是隐形剪辑，而不是穿越镜头。
墙壁或血肉的厚度必须在镜头前短暂停留，否则这个取巧的手法就会露馅。
how: 搭建一条三维路径，或使用带有可拆卸墙面的实景，然后通过合成让物体保持厚度和形状。镜头的光学表现应保持连贯（墙面不能出现融化般的失真）。
穿越屏障时的速度可以有缓入缓出的处理。提示词：Pass-through of [Subject], the camera traveling through a wall, a body, a window as if matter were optional.
when: 用它在不剪辑的情况下进入下一个房间，或者把一栋房子当作一台机械装置来处理。不要把它当作任意两个镜头之间的默认转场。
vs: 飞行穿梭转场（Flying Cam Transition）是一次穿过门槛、落在新房间中的飞行，是一种精心设计的衔接方式。穿物进入（Through Object In）则借助一个具体的道具（锁孔、杯子），通常还会伴随比例的变化。
物体传送门（Object Portal）是“物体即门”的理念。穿越机航拍（FPV Drone）可以真实地穿过一个开口；穿越镜头则可以直接无视物质本身。
examples_film: 《遁入虚空》（Enter the Void）飞越东京的一个个房间和身体，仿佛墙壁根本不存在。《搏击俱乐部》（Fight Club）的居所巡览，把一栋住宅当作一台连续运转的机械装置来处理。
语法要点：先有厚度，然后才是下一个空间。
mistakes: 最常见的误用是借助暗画面或一个经过的物体完成的剪辑。破绽在于：直接跳进一个新房间，没有任何厚度感。
解决办法：真正穿越那道屏障，并在穿越过程中保持其形状。

faq.q: 电影中的穿越镜头（Pass Through）是什么？
faq.a: 穿越镜头让摄影机以一条连续的路径穿过一面墙、一具身体或一扇窗，将物质本身视为可有可无，同时保持下一个空间的连贯性。

faq.q: 穿越镜头（Pass Through）与穿物进入（Through Object In）的区别
faq.a: 穿越镜头以建筑结构或身体作为屏障。穿物进入则通过一个具体的道具（比如锁孔或杯子）进入，通常还伴随比例的变化。

faq.q: 什么时候该用穿越镜头（Pass Through）？
faq.a: 用它在不剪辑的情况下切换房间，或者让一栋建筑显得像一台机械装置。不要把它当作廉价的划像转场来用。

faq.q: 如何为AI图像或视频撰写穿越镜头（Pass Through）的提示词？
faq.a: 说明具体的屏障和抵达的空间，并保持路径连续。示例：Pass-through of [Subject], the camera traveling through a wall, a body, a window as if matter were optional.

narrative: Cut the building, not the film. A house can become a mechanism, a club a sequence of rooms, a body a door.
The audience is given omniscient access to geography. If you hide a cut on a passing truck, you have an invisible cut, not a pass-through.
The thickness of the wall or the flesh has to occupy the lens for a moment, or the cheat will read.
how: Build a 3D route or a set with a removable wall, then composite so objects keep thickness and shape. Lens behavior should stay coherent (no melting plaster).
Speed can ease through the barrier. Prompt: Pass-through of [Subject], the camera traveling through a wall, a body, a window as if matter were optional.
when: Use it to enter the next room without a cut, or to treat a house as a machine. Do not use it as a default transition between any two shots.
vs: Flying Cam Transition is a flight that punches a threshold and lands in a new room as a designed join. Through Object In uses a named prop (keyhole, cup) and often changes scale.
Object Portal is the object-as-door idea. FPV Drone can thread a real opening; pass-through may ignore matter.
examples_film: Enter the Void flies through Tokyo rooms and bodies as if walls were optional. The Fight Club house tour treats a dwelling as a continuous mechanism.
Grammar: thickness, then the next space.
mistakes: The usual wrong cousin is a cut on a dark frame or a passing object. The tell: a pop to a new room with no thickness.
The fix: travel through the barrier and keep its shape during the passage.

faq.q: What is Pass Through in film?
faq.a: A pass-through sends the camera through a wall, body, or window as a continuous path, treating matter as optional while keeping the next space coherent.

faq.q: Pass Through vs Through Object In
faq.a: Pass-through uses architecture or a body as the barrier. Through-object-in enters via a named prop such as a keyhole or cup, often with a scale change.

faq.q: When should I use Pass Through?
faq.a: Use it to change rooms without a cut, or to make a building feel like a mechanism. Do not use it as a cheap wipe.

faq.q: How do I prompt Pass Through for AI image or video?
faq.a: Name the barrier and the arrival space, and keep the path continuous. Example: Pass-through of [Subject], the camera traveling through a wall, a body, a window as if matter were optional.
